# Google Sheets Skill for Muse

Lets Muse read and write Google Sheets through the gws command-line tool: read cell ranges, append rows (single or bulk via JSON), create spreadsheets, and run full spreadsheets API operations (batchUpdate, metadata, value ranges). Companion skills cover the two most common moves — +read (read-only, never modifies the sheet) and +append (with an explicit confirm-before-write caution). Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: requires installing the gws CLI and completing Google OAuth first (the shared auth skill is generated by running `gws generate-skills`); write operations should be confirmed with you before executing. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
